temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth denies being upset with Keith and explains that she has been short because of personal stress, apologizing for seeming curt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's explanation changes his belief from suspecting she is angry with him to understanding that she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is going through personal difficulties that are affecting her mood.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer Elizabeth support or someone to talk to.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts Keith's offer of a coffee break and thanks him, seeming receptive to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him; he wants to support her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's acceptance confirms that his offer of support is welcome and that she may be willing to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth appreciates his concern and is willing to spend time with him over coffee.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To have coffee with Elizabeth, listen to her, and offer supportive company.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her severe stresses and reacts hesitantly when Keith suggests professional help, saying she has thought about it but is unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth is under personal stress and wants to support her; he is beginning to think professional help might benefit her but worries about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's disclosures make her stress seem more severe, and her hesitant response shows she is not ready or certain about seeking professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth may need professional help but is hesitant about it; he should be careful and supportive rather than pushy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and worried about overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Elizabeth while respecting her hesitation about professional help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion, then tells Keith he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern, though it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion may have embarrassed or offended Elizabeth, and he feels regretful about overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's reassurance changes his belief: she was not offended by his suggestion, but the topic is heavy and she needs time to process it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes he did not overstep, Elizabeth appreciates his concern, and she is still contemplating what to do.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure Elizabeth, avoid pressuring her, and remain available for support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth thanks Keith, says his support means a lot, and tells him she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him after their previous conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Elizabeth's explicit appreciation confirms and strengthens his belief that his support is meaningful to her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Keith believes Elizabeth values his support, feels more comfortable, and feels better knowing he is there for her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain this supportive relationship and continue being available to Elizabeth.
